title: Sin Hurts More Than You
verse: Israel has sinned; they have violated my covenantal commandment! They have taken some of the riches; they have stolen them and deceitfully put them among their own possessions.
observation: Hurting people hurt people. When we are in sin or brokenness, it doesn’t just affect us. It comes out in ways we don’t even realize and affects others. We don’t live on an island. What we do affects others in ways we don’t realize. Therefore, we walk with repentant hearts not just for our sake, but the wholeness of others we encounter.
application: Keep your heart right before God.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for reminding us that our lives are not just our own. They affect others too.
